requested_outcome: Repair the remaining verified multilingual and map defects, publish one frozen production release, and approve only after full post-deploy verification.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co across Hebrew, English, Russian and French homepage, search, map and representative detail routes
authorization_boundary: Code repair, testing and production publication are authorized. Accessibility and typography testing are explicitly excluded. No supplier-data invention, legal claim, payment, booking, lead or destructive infrastructure action is authorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user is launching and explicitly asked for end-to-end repair rather than a scoped code claim.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact deployed version must pass the affected family at its public destination and receive an independent verdict.

lesson_bundle.reason: Multilingual leakage and map behavior occur in shared page families.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: A shared fix must be verified across every affected locale, world and viewport.

lesson_bundle.reason: Localized supplier content must remain truthful and maps must use real eligible records.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: No fabricated translations, business names, locations, availability or map records may be introduced.

lesson_bundle.reason: Localized public routes and launch readiness affect canonical, hreflang, sitemap and crawl behavior.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Post-deploy locale SEO, sitemap, robots and representative routes must remain correct.

lesson_bundle.reason: The defects include mixed-language layouts, card collisions and map selected-card behavior.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Desktop, mobile and low-height screenshots must remain coherent without hiding content to make tests pass.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The language switch changes the chrome but leaves Hebrew supplier content inside English, Russian or French pages.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Trace every leaked node to a shared localization boundary and use truthful localized source data or explicit neutral fallbacks without inventing business facts.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The multilingual production matrix reports no Hebrew script leakage or rejected French literals on the affected routes.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The map appears to work on one phone but hangs or cannot select a place on desktop or a short viewport.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Instrument the full map state transition and distinguish missing results, dynamic import, tile readiness, marker interaction and selected-card rendering.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Vacation, events, hourly, spa and activities map cases pass on desktop, 390-pixel mobile and low-height viewport.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A broad localization fix hides business identity or replaces missing translations with invented marketing copy.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve verified names and facts, use existing translations or deterministic honest fallbacks, and keep unsupported content visibly unavailable rather than fabricated.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Representative cards and detail pages retain identity, contact actions, photos and factual data in all supported locales.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The repair passes locally but the public release still serves the old behavior or regresses SEO and conversions.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Freeze one commit, run the complete local gate, deploy that exact commit once, then repeat public QA, SEO and authenticated report checks with rollback recorded.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Public release identity matches the tested commit, critical routes pass, and the independent checker approves the exact deployed version.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The task is called finished even though the comprehensive QA still contains failed cases.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Reconcile every prior failure as fixed, disproven with stronger evidence, or a precise launch blocker.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The final report contains zero in-scope failures; otherwise the release verdict remains not ready.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After one representative non-Hebrew page and one representative map pass with causal evidence, before expanding the fix or publishing.
checks: No Hebrew supplier content leaks on the representative localized page without hiding business identity
Map trace proves the exact failed stage and the representative world completes selection
Focused regression tests pass for shared localization and map components

attack_questions: Does a cold direct request still expose Hebrew after hydration in any non-Hebrew route?
Can each map open, load markers, select a marker, show a card and close on every required viewport?
Did the fix remove or falsify business identity, content, phone, WhatsApp, booking or SEO data?
Does reload, back navigation or a locale switch restore the correct route and state?
Does the exact public release pass the same comprehensive audit that previously failed?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact production release URL, version and screenshots or browser observations for the affected routes
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Complete automated matrix plus independent checker across locales, worlds and viewports

effectiveness.baseline: Production version 609 comprehensive audit: 148 cases, 88 passed and 60 failed; core rerun: 39 cases, 32 passed and 7 failed.
effectiveness.target: Zero in-scope failures on the frozen post-deploy candidate without loss of verified business or conversion behavior.
